Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Receives an additional Ki +1 per Ki Sphere obtained
- High chance of performing a critical hit
*For 5 turns from the character's entry turn*
- Randomly changes Ki Spheres of a certain Type to STR Ki Spheres
- Damage reduction rate 70%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Guards all attacks
*Starting from the 6th turn from the character's entry turn*
- Damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g} per Ki Sphere obtained (up to 70%)
*For every STR Ki Sphere obtained*
- ATK & DEF 60%{passiveImg:up_g}
- All allies' ATK & DEF 10%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 50%)
- All enemies' DEF 10%{passiveImg:down_y} (no more than -50%)
*For every Type Ki Sphere obtained (STR excluded)*
- DEF 70%{passiveImg:up_g}
- All enemies' ATK 10%{passiveImg:down_y} (no more than -30%)
*When the Finish Effect is activated, or when attacking with
18 or more Ki*
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Interrupts the attacked enemy
*When receiving an attack with 18 or more Ki*
- DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When the Finish Effect is activated, or when attacking with 24 Ki*
- ATK 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Performs a critical hit when there is a "Pure Saiyans" Category enemy
or an Extreme Class enemy
